items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I went to Chicago and heard him playing with King Oliver.

ctx.x: But, at this time you hadn't heard Louis Armstrong or King Oliver or anybody like that?
No, I heard Louis Armstrong right after that. I went to Chicago and heard him playing with King Oliver.

items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I was in Chicago -- yeah, Louis was with King Oliver Arthur. That's where I heard him, in a ballroom there, in an old dance ballroom.

ctx.x: I mean, if Louis was with --
Let me see, now. I was in Chicago -- yeah, Louis was with King Oliver Arthur. That's where I heard him, in a ballroom there, in an old dance ballroom.
